description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notify under the Registered Stock and Securities Ordinance, that the repeal of regulation 9 and substitute therefore.
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance and Mass Media under the Registered Stock and Securities Ordinance, specifically amending regulations related to the examination, investigation, and supervision of Primary Dealer Companies. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework amendments, compliance requirements, and supervisory procedures for financial institutions, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While a minister is named, this is incidental to the regulatory content rather than being about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
